mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% year-over-year triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls and housing starts indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS and HOUST rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Positive GDP growth (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates labor market tightness that fuels wage inflation, prompting Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates combined with strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) indicate aggressive monetary policy suppressing economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and PAYEMS growth fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1300 thousand units signal immediate consumer demand strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1300.
